name: trend-radar
description: Audit fashion observations before calling a trend.

interface.longDescription: Audit fashion observations before calling a trend. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Audit dated observations; Group independent source observations; Compare a trend with your constraints. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me group independent source observations.

prompts: Help me group independent source observations.
Help me compare a trend with your constraints.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Signal Ledger: Fashion Trends workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me audit dated observations with these supplied values: {"as_of":"2026-11-07","window_days":30,"observations":[{"claim":"Wide-leg trousers","source":"https://example.com/editorial","observed_on":"2026-11-01","channel":"editorial"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses trend_radar_evidence_window with the supplied inputs. Returns {"observations":[{"claim":"Wide-leg trousers","source":"https://example.com/editorial","observed_on":"2026-11-01","channel":"editorial","age_days":6,"in_window":true,"source_domain":"example.com"}],"note":"Audits supplied provenance and dates; does not fetch articles or measure popularity."}. Shows the actual timeline result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Group independent source observations. Reproducible inputs: {"observations":[{"trend":"Wide-leg trousers","source_domain":"publication-a.com","channel":"editorial"},{"trend":"Wide-leg trousers","source_domain":"publication-b.com","channel":"runway"},{"trend":"Wide-leg trousers","source_domain":"publication-a.com","channel":"editorial"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me group independent source observations with these supplied values: {"observations":[{"trend":"Wide-leg trousers","source_domain":"publication-a.com","channel":"editorial"},{"trend":"Wide-leg trousers","source_domain":"publication-b.com","channel":"runway"},{"trend":"Wide-leg trousers","source_domain":"publication-a.com","channel":"editorial"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses trend_radar_corroboration_map with the supplied inputs. Returns {"trends":[{"trend":"wide-leg trousers","observations":3,"independent_domains":["publication-a.com","publication-b.com"],"channels":["editorial","runway"]}],"note":"Distinct domains are a provenance cue, not proof of independent reporting or popularity."}. Shows the actual radar result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare a trend with your constraints. Reproducible inputs: {"budget":150,"required_tags":["neutral"],"items":[{"name":"Oxford shirt","category":"top","price":60,"tags":["collared","neutral"]},{"name":"Trousers","category":"bottom","price":80,"tags":["tailored","neutral"]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare a trend with your constraints with these supplied values: {"budget":150,"required_tags":["neutral"],"items":[{"name":"Oxford shirt","category":"top","price":60,"tags":["collared","neutral"]},{"name":"Trousers","category":"bottom","price":80,"tags":["tailored","neutral"]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses trend_radar_wearability_budget with the supplied inputs. Returns {"items":[{"name":"Oxford shirt","category":"top","price":60,"tags":["collared","neutral"],"within_budget":true,"missing_tags":[],"eligible":true},{"name":"Trousers","category":"bottom","price":80,"tags":["tailored","neutral"],"within_budget":true,"missing_tags":[],"eligible":true}]}. Shows the actual wardrobe result. Does not fabricate external data.
